arxiv-2007-08243.description: Abstract We analyse the pruning procedure behind the lottery ticket hypothesis [ 4 ] , iterative magnitude pruning (IMP), when applied to linear models trained by gradient flow. arxiv-2501-03142.description: Abstract Deep reinforcement learning (RL) policies can demonstrate unsafe behaviors and are challenging to interpret. The relationship between P. bursaria and symbiotic Chlorella spp. is characterized by mutualism, in which both organisms benefit from this association.
